judge_input.description:
## Motivation

- What this whole thing is really about is the incremental, step-by-step process of going and adding typing over to `vega-util`, doing so a little bit at a time
- It is also related to the particular issue that can be found over at https://github.com/vega/vega/issues/3971

## Changes

- Adds in a brand new runtime error, and this is specifically there for the particular case that ends up arising in the situation when users go and try to operate on a domain which does not, as it happens, have within it at least 1 single value at all for them to actually work with
- Everything else that there is beyond that should just keep right on having exactly the very same runtime behavior as it always did happen to have from before this change; the one and only thing that I actually went ahead and did here in this PR was to go and add in the types themselves, and quite honestly nothing at all more than just that

## Testing

```vasg
npm test --workspace=vega-util -- test/transform-test
```
judge_input.title: refactor(vega-util): Make `transform` functions typesafe
